parameters.query:
-- Warum passt keine Buchung zu einem Angebot?
-- Verglichen werden Form, Praefix und tatsaechliche Ueberschneidung.

WITH b AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT offer_id FROM edoobox_raw.booking
    WHERE is_deleted = false AND offer_id IS NOT NULL
),
o AS (
    SELECT offer_id FROM edoobox_raw.offer
),
formen AS (
    SELECT 'Buchung' AS herkunft,
           split_part(offer_id, '_', 1)                  AS praefix,
           count(*)                                      AS anzahl,
           min(length(offer_id))                         AS laenge_min,
           max(length(offer_id))                         AS laenge_max,
           min(offer_id)                                 AS beispiel
    FROM b GROUP BY 2
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Angebot',
           split_part(offer_id, '_', 1),
           count(*), min(length(offer_id)), max(length(offer_id)), min(offer_id)
    FROM o GROUP BY 2
),
ueberschneidung AS (
    SELECT 'ZUSAMMENFASSUNG' AS herkunft,
           'Treffer' AS praefix,
           (SELECT count(*) FROM b JOIN o USING (offer_id)) AS anzahl,
           (SELECT count(*) FROM b) AS laenge_min,
           (SELECT count(*) FROM o) AS laenge_max,
           '' AS beispiel
),
-- Passt der mittlere Teil der Kennung zusammen, nur mit anderem Praefix?
mittelteil AS (
    SELECT 'ZUSAMMENFASSUNG' AS herkunft,
           'Treffer nur Mittelteil' AS praefix,
           (SELECT count(*)
              FROM b JOIN o
                ON split_part(b.offer_id, '_', 2) = split_part(o.offer_id, '_', 2)) AS anzahl,
           0 AS laenge_min, 0 AS laenge_max, '' AS beispiel
)
SELECT * FROM formen
UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ueberschneidung
UNION ALL SELECT * FROM mittelteil
ORDER BY herkunft, praefix;
